subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the workflow and security owners accept these reviewed upstream action revisions for secret-, publishing-, repository-write-, and code-scanning jobs on the final rebased head?
rationale: The YAML changes are mechanically correct, but merging intentionally trusts new third-party executable code at security-sensitive workflow boundaries, which requires owner acceptance rather than automated repair.

options.title: Approve final rebased head
options.body: Accept the reviewed revisions after required secops/release review and all exact-head workflow gates complete.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Land routine setup-action bumps separately and hold Codex, token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, labeler, or stale revisions for narrower owner review.

options.title: Keep existing pins
options.body: Pause the grouped update if owners are not ready to accept the new executable revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve final rebased head
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed revisions after required secops/release review and all exact-head workflow gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest individual history signal is recent ownership of the Docker release path, while CODEOWNERS separately routes security workflows to secops.
